metadataRaw.title: How to Decompress YOUR KNEE for Instant Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to decompress your knee for INSTANT pain relief! 

These decompression exercises are geared towards relieving pressure in and around the knee. How they work is through pulling motions, or TRACTION. Think of a very good stretch that helps open up the knee capsule and makes it feel more loose.

Decompression exercises are effective in many ways, such as helping to decrease muscle stiffness and taking pressure off the knees that may be causing aches and pains across the legs. 

All of these decompression exercises are safe, effective and can be done AT HOME! As a bonus, you may find they give quick knee pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now and learn how to decompress your knees at home!
